title: Operating cost increase: size versus growth rate
question: Total operating costs rose between FY2024 and FY2025. What drove the increase?

gold_answer.summary: Total operating costs rose GBP 600k (+13.0%) to GBP 5,200k. Marketing accounts for GBP 450k of that, or 75.0% of the increase, growing 45.0%. Salaries added GBP 120k (+4.0%), which is 20.0% of the increase. Rent and travel together added GBP 30k. Travel grew 20.0% but from a small base, so it is immaterial.
gold_answer.main_driver: Marketing spend: 75.0% of the total increase.

design_note: Baseline, focused on C4 materiality. Two distractors: salaries is the largest line but grew only 4.0%; travel has the second-highest growth rate but adds only GBP 20k. A response that leads with either, or gives all four lines equal weight, fails C4.
